title: Cold-chain source event, contract v1
description: One Kafka record value. Timestamps are RFC 3339 and evaluated in UTC; startTime/endTime form a half-open interval [startTime, endTime) at whole-second precision. Fields not named here are ignored and excluded from the semantic payload hash. Model.parse is the enforcing implementation; this schema documents it.

eventId.description: Globally unique across all kinds; keeps one kind across revisions

revision.description: Correction counter; the highest revision supersedes. A retry of the same eventId and revision must carry the same semantic payload

eventTime.description: When the source recorded the fact; at most 5 minutes after the Kafka record timestamp

productCode.description: Product (SKU) code that specifications apply to

temperatureC.description: Degrees Celsius, assumed uniform over the reading interval

maxC.description: Highest acceptable temperature, inclusive; must be >= minC

maxExcursionSeconds.description: Seconds of cumulative excursion allowed before quality review

childId.description: The packed item: a serialized unit (its productId), carton or pallet

parentId.description: The packaging that holds the child

parentLevel.description: Must be above childLevel in UNIT < CARTON < PALLET < CONTAINER

then.description: Topic coldchain.sensors; endTime at most 5 minutes after the Kafka record timestamp
Topic coldchain.traceability; childId differs from parentId and parentLevel is above childLevel (both enforced in code)
A packed unit carries its product code and lot
